name: Potion of Heroism

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 10 Temporary Hit Points and Bless (no Concentration) for 1 hour.
text: For 1 hour after drinking it, you have 10 Temporary Hit Points that last until they're spent, and you're under the effect of the Bless spell (no Concentration needed): add 1d4 to your attack rolls and saving throws. The blue potion bubbles and steams as if boiling.
